history.summary: Freehold 1335 sqft 3BR at The Glacier (D15) at $2.25M / $1685 PSF, ~5% above the $1610 median. The eye-catching 9.59% CAGR is built on just 7 transactions — too thin to trust — and the development is 1km / 12-min from Eunos MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold in deep-pool D15 at a liquid $2.25M quantum is a sound base, but the standout 9.59% CAGR rests on only 7 txns and should be heavily discounted — likely noise, not a real trend. Entry sits above the $1610 district median (no discount), and the 1km walk to Eunos is mediocre transit. A decent freehold D15 hold, but nothing in the data justifies a Buy; the headline appreciation is a statistical mirage.

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Moderate. D15 tenant demand is solid, but distance from MRT and a large freehold 3BR skew toward family own-stay over the transient rental pool.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Discount the 9.59% (7 txns) heavily; realistic expectation is around the RCR baseline for a freehold D15 mid-block. No specific catalyst to drive outperformance.
